slides.h1: Your App Store page is a landing page.

slides.lead: They see your icon, name and first screenshots. That's usually it. Make those count.
Not your login screen. Show the pain your app removes, in a few big words.
One screenshot per key action. Real screens, short captions.

slides.h2: Say what it is in plain words.
slides.lead: Your subtitle should tell a stranger what the app does and who it's for.
If you run Search Ads, people land here with an intent. Make the page answer it fast.

points: Captions you can read on a phone

slides.h2: Great apps still need a great page.
